title: A Dig at Saqqara
text: An excavation team has broken into a sealed chamber. The foreman will let you look, if you are quick.

pass.text: You recognize the one object in the chamber that matters, and you take it.

fail.text: The air in the chamber is very old, and very angry.

title: The Great Bazaar
text: Lanterns, spices, brass, and a merchant who says he has exactly what you need.

pass.text: You drink three glasses of tea, and he gives you a gift.

fail.text: You buy something you did not want, at a price you cannot afford.

title: The Museum Storeroom
text: The museum keeps its most disturbing finds in a storeroom that is not on any floor plan.

pass.text: You read the catalogue cards by flashlight.

fail.text: A guard catches you, and the museum presses charges.

title: The Unwrapped
text: A mummy was unwrapped at a society dinner last night. This morning the sarcophagus is empty.

pass.text: You find the hieroglyph that names what it was waiting for.
